exchanges.question: Explain what api-claude found about the invoice job.
exchanges.orchestrator: The nightly invoice job failed because it sent the invoices to the payment provider one at a time, and the provider cut it off after the first hundred. About four thousand invoices never went out, and those customers will get them a day late unless the job is re-run before morning. It handled the old nightly volume fine, and only broke when the month started. Shall I have it re-run the job now with the quick fix, or start on the proper one? The job asks the payment provider to charge each customer, but only a limited number of charges are allowed per minute, so most of them were turned away. There is no built-in retry, so a rejected charge was simply skipped, and re-sending is safe because the provider ignores an invoice it has already seen. api-claude suggests re-running now with a simple wait-and-retry, and doing the proper fix using the provider's bulk method later. Options: Re-run now with the quick fix, then do the proper fix; Do the proper fix first; Do nothing yet.
